subject: SOC 2 Type II: minimum evidence package & delegation steps
messages:
From: Elena Morales <emorales@quantumai.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report & minimum evidence request

Hi Lauren,

We're starting our vendor evaluation and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report and the minimum artifact bundle you can provide for a quick operational review. Specifically: audit period dates used for the Type II, a list of what you can share without an NDA (sample logs, configuration snapshots, SOC 2 report PDF), and any preferred transfer method (SFTP, secure Drive link, DocuSign for bridge letters).

Our security team prefers examples of access logs and a short bridge letter if the report doesn't cover a specific subservice. Can you confirm timing — we need deliverables within 5 business days if possible.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Director, InfoSec
QuantumAI
[Elena mobile: +1-415-555-0142]

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <emorales@quantumai.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report & minimum evidence request

Elena —

Thanks for the clear ask. Quick answers and an attached plan below. We can meet the 5-business-day window for the minimal package. High-level: 

- Audit period: 2025-08-01 through 2026-07-31 (Type II) — final report attached as PDF.
- Minimum shareable package (no NDA required):
  * SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — redacted where necessary
  * Short summary (one-page) of scope and in-scope systems (attached)
  * Sample access logs (time-limited sample, CSV)
  * Configuration snapshot examples (screenshots / JSON snippets)
  * Response templates for any follow-ups (we include a short FAQ)

- Preferred transfer options: secure Drive link (pre-signed, restricted access) or encrypted SFTP. We also provide a draft bridge letter if you need statements about partial coverage.

I've attached a short "minimum package" checklist and a draft bridge letter. Marissa — I'm looping you and Dev to prepare the actual files and generate a pre-signed Drive folder. Dev, can you include a 7-day sample of access logs (sanitized) and put the bridge_letter_draft.docx in the folder?

Sample replies you can paste back to your team are below (short, to the point):

1) If they ask "What is the audit period?" — paste: "Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report covers 2025-08-01 through 2026-07-31."

2) If they ask "Can you share access logs?" — paste: "Yes — we can provide a time-limited sample of sanitized access logs (CSV) showing authentication events and admin activity; see attached sample."

3) If they ask "What transfer methods are supported?" — paste: "We can share via restricted Google Drive link, SFTP with temporary credentials, or secure third-party transfer. Let us know your preferred method and we will provision."

I'll follow up once Marissa/Dev have uploaded the folder.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
VP, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_soc2_typeii_summary.pdf]

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-28T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: ACTION: assemble QuantumAI minimal SOC 2 package (due 5 business days)

Marissa / Dev —

Please use the checklist attached to assemble the minimum package for QuantumAI per Elena's request. Priority items: SOC 2 PDF (redacted), 7-day sanitized access log sample (CSV), and the bridge_letter_draft.docx. Deliverables should live in a restricted Drive folder; set viewer expiry to 30 days and restrict downloading where possible.

Dev: run the log sanitizer with these rules: remove IPs > mask last octet, remove user PII, keep event_type, timestamp, actor_id (hashed), resource, and action. Produce access_logs_sample.csv and attach a small README describing the sanitization steps.

Marissa: check the SOC 2 PDF for vendor-only redactions and confirm scope lines are intact. Add the one-page scope summary (redwood_soc2_typeii_summary.pdf).

Put upload confirmation back to this thread when complete. If anything needs legal review (redactions that affect report meaning), escalate to me directly.

Thanks — Lauren

From: Elena Morales <emorales@quantumai.io>

Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report & minimum evidence request

Thanks Lauren / Marissa — received the folder and samples; access works fine. We have two quick follow-ups:

1) Can you confirm the final signed date on the SOC 2 report and the auditor firm name? (we want the exact signature date for our compliance tracker).
2) The bridge letter looks good — can you amend paragraph 2 to add this sentence: "Redwood's Type II scope excludes customer-managed encryption keys and client-side data processing"? If that's acceptable, we can accept the draft and mark the request as complete.

If you can confirm by EOD tomorrow, we'll close the review.

Elena
